title: Delete the selected first disabled strategy and its own history with per-step timings
author: agent:/root

originalRequests.text: Продумай детальный план удаления ненужных стратегий и их историй. Этот план должен включать в себя необходимые шаги и быть максимально безопасен для продакшен сервера
Возьми первую стратегию с Enabled = false и прогони её по своему плану. При этом сделай логгирование времени работы каждого шага. Потом проанилизируем

scope.goal: Delete exactly the UUID-first disabled strategy selected by the user, together with all exclusively owned structured history, following the production-safe plan with restoration removed and retaining reproducible per-step timing evidence.
inScope: Production PostgreSQL 192.168.0.101:5432/polycopytrader only. Exact target UUID=b7c50005-0000-4000-8182-000000000103; code=btc_up_down_5m_futures_basis_bps_3_fak_premarket; name=BTC Up or Down 5m 3 bps Futures Basis Premarket; wallet=strategy:btc_up_down_5m_futures_basis_bps_3_fak_premarket. User reply 1 selects the previously displayed UUID-first candidate, not the name/code-first candidate. The selected target is frozen; do not select a replacement automatically if its state changes.

All exclusively owned structured history without a date restriction: Paper orders/fills, strategy-market runs, signals/rejections, closed positions/settlements, skip archives/rollups, exclusively attributable historical accounting audit and fee-backfill telemetry, strategy/wallet derived projections, performance snapshots, states and queues. Prove exact ownership and source-row dependency before deletion; shared or retained-strategy references block that deletion.

Fresh preliminary read-only preview on 2026-09-17T19:16Z..19:20Z: target Enabled=false/LiveStakes=false; 12168 orders/fills/signals, 16300 raw runs, 12167 zero-size positions/settlements, 2158 archive-v1 rows, 0 archive-v2 rows, 94 rollups, 0 signal rejections; 12167 position projection facts. These are measured preliminary counts, not a complete ownership proof or complete audit/telemetry inventory. Complete and refresh the required dependency/ownership/writer/schema/health preview before mutation.

Use one task-specific native PowerShell/SQL operation restricted to this exact UUID/code/wallet, with a separate journal and focused isolated synthetic-data test harness. Reuse verified bounded SQL concepts from the existing 276-target implementation without invoking its full driver, changing its targets, or changing its existing report/contract. No generalized deletion framework.

Run one complete owned financial chain as a real mutation pilot after all pre-apply gates pass. Choose subsequent chain batch sizes and residual-row limits from measured transaction duration, source closure size and current load; record exact expected rows, batch counts and revised ETA before proceeding. Process serially, with a durable resume journal, and delete the strategy definition last. An oversized indivisible chain or a need for materially different coordination stops work for a separate decision.

Each financial chain batch is independently atomic and preserves referential/accounting closure. Acquire verified target-row/wallet and required existing worker-coordination locks only within reviewed bounded transactions; explicitly bound and log total transaction/coordination duration, not only individual SQL statements. Preserve race protection and recheck identity/flags/ownership before committing. Do not hold the existing unbounded guardian transaction throughout the whole strategy cleanup. Constraints and triggers remain enabled; account for DELETE-generated events and cached-worker telemetry before final completion.

Use transaction-local statement and lock timeouts, conservative single-worker execution and measured pauses. Stop before another batch on unexpected affected rows, new active/future/Live state, non-target ownership, changed deployed process/schema, errors/latency/queue/lock/load deterioration beyond the predeclared measured baseline gates, or unknown commit outcome. Reconcile exact identifiers before retrying. Do not interrupt unrelated service sessions or remove safeguards to make progress.

Recovery/restoration is removed from the plan by the user's explicit latest instruction. Do not create or require a backup, dump, archival copy, restore test or existing recovery proof. Confirmed deletion batches are irreversible in this operation; rollback protects only the current uncommitted transaction. Keep commit-outcome reconciliation and safe resumption, which are not restoration of deleted data.

Record UTC start/end, monotonic elapsed time, step/substep, target, batch identity, expected/actual row counts where applicable, outcome and error for every executed operational phase and SQL batch, including failed attempts, postchecks and cleanup. Record pending/skipped phases without invented zero durations. Keep query/script hashes and distinguish client elapsed time from server timestamps and user approval waits. Preserve earlier read-only timing evidence and disclose that initial bootstrap/source exploration was not instrumented.

Verify the exact final target graph is absent, every batch is reconciled, and task-caused effects remain inside the approved identifiers. Verify retained strategy identities and relevant history baselines with legitimate concurrent activity reported separately; limited hash samples are not proof about all retained history. Require independent semantic and operation review before apply and final completion.

Read-only preflight and later pilot provide the execution estimate; full deletion duration is unknown before calibration. Report measured throughput and remaining ETA without treating elapsed time alone as a stop condition. Any single new long-running/resource-intensive action outside the explicit deletion request requires separate authorization.
outOfScope: Every other strategy and its own history, including enabled LowerEnter UUID b7c50005-0001-4000-8182-000000000103 and the other 275 previously frozen disabled strategies; no dependency deletion, reassignment or automatic replacement target.
Shared market data, prices, reference feeds, shared archive dictionaries and retained-strategy source records; no broad cleanup or retrospective performance analysis.

Application source/catalog changes, new schemas/indexes/triggers, migration edits, service stop/restart/deployment, configuration or strategy flag changes, Live exchange/order actions and local user-database writes.
Backup, dump, clone, archival copy, restoration or a restore-evidence gate, as explicitly removed by the user; no VACUUM FULL, table rewrite, broad table lock or trigger bypass.

Changes to scripts/operations/Delete-DisabledStrategies-20260915.ps1, Codex/Reports/2026-09-15-disabled-strategies-deletion.json or the prior 276-target contract; unrelated dirty work remains untouched.
scope.periodOrFilter: One frozen UUID/code/wallet selected as option 1 from Enabled=false ordered by UUID; all exclusively owned structured history, no date cutoff, UTC evidence. Recheck Enabled=false and LiveStakes=false immediately before each bounded mutation.
scope.firstVerification: Timed read-only identity/health query using explicit BEGIN READ ONLY, statement_timeout=15s, lock_timeout=1s, UTC and sequential queries, then per-table counts, exact ownership and cross-reference closure, active-state/writer gates, deployed build and migration/schema proof.

requirements.text: Run the deletion plan for exactly the selected first disabled strategy and all its exclusively owned structured history while protecting the production service and every retained strategy.
requirements.sourceQuote: Возьми первую стратегию с Enabled = false и прогони её по своему плану.
acceptanceCriteria: Only b7c50005-0000-4000-8182-000000000103 and proven exclusively owned dependent rows are deleted; no selected strategy replacement or deletion of its enabled LowerEnter variant.
A complete fresh preflight, independently reviewed exact script/SQL, bounded coordination and transaction design, and healthy writer/active-state gates precede even the pilot.

Before the pilot, focused isolated native PostgreSQL tests with synthetic fixtures verify exact owned/unowned rows, foreign references and DELETE triggers, concurrent writers, bounded timeout/rollback, replay/resumption and lost acknowledgement around COMMIT. No production data clone or user database is used; disposable files and database live only in the owned marked D:/CodexTemp run. The test runtime must support the relevant production PostgreSQL semantics; an unavailable required runtime or material resource expansion is reported before provisioning.

The pilot and all subsequent batches have exact expected/actual identifiers and counts, finite transaction/lock durations and unambiguous or reconciled commit outcomes; stopped work reports exact completed and remaining scope.

Final definition and approved history absence, retained-boundary checks, delayed-writer/telemetry checks and continuing production activity are independently verified; no excluded source, schema, service or order actions are performed.

verification.command: Review exact one-target script syntax, immutable target restrictions, source/schema/trigger/worker interactions, complete read-only ownership preview and bounded transaction/resume behavior independently before apply.
verification.expected: No open scope, ownership, race, unbounded-lock or commit-reconciliation finding; exact deployed identity and fresh preflight evidence bind the review.
verification.evidence: Preliminary timed identity/core/direct-reference checks completed; full source closure, retained JSON/source references, audit/telemetry inventory and executable review remain pending.

verification.command: Run the approved one-chain pilot, independently verify its exact effects and production health, then execute measured serial batches and final one-target absence/retained-boundary verification.
verification.expected: All intended exact target-owned records removed and independently verified, no unintended task-caused effects, no unreconciled batch or service degradation accepted as completion.
verification.evidence: No mutation performed for this request.

verification.command: Run scripts/operations/Test-Delete-OneDisabledStrategy-20260917.ps1 against an owned isolated native PostgreSQL synthetic fixture; exercise exact ownership and foreign references, DELETE triggers, concurrent writer exclusion, timeouts, repeated batches/resumption and lost acknowledgement around COMMIT.
verification.expected: All focused safety and reconciliation cases pass with bounded lock/transaction duration and preserved non-target fixtures; no production clone, backup or user-database write occurs.
verification.evidence: Test harness has not been implemented or run; approval and subsequent focused verification are required before the production pilot.

requirements.text: Log the elapsed time and outcome of each operational step for the user's later analysis.
requirements.sourceQuote: При этом сделай логгирование времени работы каждого шага.
acceptanceCriteria: Every executed step and batch, including failed attempts and postchecks, records UTC start/end and measured monotonic elapsed time with target and outcome; nested steps are identified to avoid double-counting.
The durable timing report retains SQL/script hashes, actual row counts, errors and pending/skipped stages; no unexecuted deletion time or retrospective bootstrap time is fabricated.
The final response links the timing evidence and states precisely whether deletion completed or stopped, leaving broader timing/performance analysis for the user's later request.

verification.command: Reconcile executed step and batch records with monotonic timers, failures, SQL/script hashes and durable journal; inspect partial and final reports independently.
verification.expected: No executed operational phase missing a duration/outcome; uninstrumented preparatory exploration is disclosed and pending phases are not represented as executed.
verification.evidence: Initial selection and selected-target read-only SQL timings are retained under outputs/single-disabled-timing-20260917; apply timings do not exist yet.

requirements.text: Remove restoration from the plan and its execution gates without removing transaction rollback and commit-outcome reconciliation.
acceptanceCriteria: No backup/restore or recovery-evidence requirement blocks this task; no backup, dump, clone or archival copy is created by it.
The report distinguishes rollback of an uncommitted transaction from irreversible committed deletion and retains reconciliation/resumption safeguards.

verification.command: Inspect the exact script and reports for absence of backup/restore actions or gates and presence of rollback/commit-reconciliation safeguards.
verification.expected: The latest user instruction is applied literally and no removed restoration requirement is silently reintroduced.
verification.evidence: The earlier recovery-location check is retained as historical timing evidence only; the user explicitly removed restoration before mutation.
